newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-MOYA TO PLAY NORMAN IN AMSTERDAM SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MOYA TO PLAY NORMAN IN AMSTERDAM SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Carlos Moya and Magnus Norman booked their places in the semifinals of the Amsterdam Open with straight-set victories on Friday.
The fourth-seeded Norman beat Christian Ruud of Norway 6-3 7-6 after dominating the first set and resisting a second-set comeback by Ruud to take a close tiebreak 8-6.
The Swede now faces top seed and world number 10 Moya who beat compatriot Francisco Clavet 6-3 6-4.
In a battle of the baseliners, the two Spanish clay-court specialists produced some high-class rallies.
Moya's greater power was telling as he moved his opponent around the court, hitting outright winners, while Clavet did not help his cause with a rash of unforced errors.
The second semifinal pits Marcelo Philippini of Uruguay against Slava Dosedel of the Czech Republic. Both are unseeded.
